name: FAIR Universe HiggsML Uncertainty Challenge
description: The task involves estimating the signal strength parameter (µ) for Higgs boson events relative to the Standard Model prediction, along with a 68.27% Confidence Interval (CI), accounting for systematic uncertainties and distribution shifts.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: The input consists of tabular data in parquet format with primary features (e.g., PRI_had_pt, PRI_met) and derived features (e.g., DER_mass_transverse_met_lep, DER_mass_vis). Training data includes binary labels (1 for signal, 0 for background), while test data is unlabelled and includes systematic biases from six nuisance parameters.
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output is a 68.27% Confidence Interval for the signal strength parameter µ, represented by two values: mu16 (lower bound) and mu84 (upper bound). µtrue varies between 0.1 and 3.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for each pseudo-experiment, e.g., experiment_001

field.name: mu16
field.description: lower bound of the 68.27% Confidence Interval for the signal strength parameter µ

field.name: mu84
field.description: upper bound of the 68.27% Confidence Interval for the signal strength parameter µ

cr:evaluation.notes: The Quantile Score is computed as -ln((w + ϵ)f(c)), where w is the average CI width, c is the coverage, f(c) is an asymmetric penalty function targeting 68.27% coverage, and ϵ = 10^-2 is a regularization term. Binomial statistical error (σ68) is incorporated based on the number of pseudo-experiments.
